create_sam_optimizer: create a SAM optimizer wrapping an outer optimizer and an adversarial optimizer with configurable sync period
create_normalize_transformation: create a gradient normalization transformation that scales gradients to unit norm
build_sam_with_opaque_mode: build a SAM optimizer in opaque mode to hide adversarial updates from batch norm statistics
create_sam_state: create a SAM state holding steps_since_sync, outer optimizer state, adversarial optimizer state, and parameter cache
run_sam_with_grad_fn: run SAM optimizer with a gradient function that takes params and adversarial step index
